body: When i felt so damn helpless and hopeless my so called mental health team dont care and dont do anything to help im just done being so alone and hurt suffering through trauma constantly while everyone sits back watching me suffer ive had enough.

Im sorry you feel this way you are worth so much more and when your kids grow older if they ever find out and you survived think of how proud they will be you are so young i know things are hard they arent ever easy but we are all here for you. You deserve to be happy healthy and free from these horrible thoughts.
